overview.description: The ProShares K-1 Free Crude Oil ETF of Benef Interest (OILK) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in crude oil commodities. The fund tracks an index holding three separate contracts at equal-weighting with different roll schedules. OILK was launched on Sep 26, 2016 and is issued by ProShares.
